biggest_catch: The $60 is bill credit, not cash — it only lowers your Google Fi service bill, can't be applied to a device purchase, and you (and your friend) must stay active for 30 consecutive days and pay the first bill before either side sees a cent.
catches: The credit is not cash: it applies only to monthly service costs (data, calls, texts, device protection) — never to phone purchases or financing.
Your friend must activate a full-service plan within 30 days of getting your code.
Both parties must stay active 30 consecutive days and the friend must pay the first bill in full.
Referrer cap: $600 in referral bill credit total.
Google can void credits tied to abuse, mass misuse, or fraud.

c2.evidence: Official Google Fi referral page and referral ToS state: $60 bill credit to each party per qualifying referral; referrer cap $600.

c3.evidence: No fee to give or use a referral code.

c4.evidence: Official page states the credit is applied to subsequent bills after 30 consecutive active days and payment of the first bill.

eligibility: Google Fi customer with a full-service plan to refer. Friend must be a new Fi customer (or meet the new-customer definition), activate within 30 days, stay active 30 consecutive days, and pay the first bill in full. US residents 18+.

steps: Open your Google Fi app or fi.google.com and get your referral code/link.
Share it with a friend who is new to Google Fi.
Your friend signs up with your code and activates a full-service Fi plan within 30 days.
Your friend keeps service active for 30 consecutive days and pays the first bill in full.
You each receive $60 in Fi bill credit on subsequent bills (you can earn up to $600 total as a referrer).
